issues.title: Don't get `confirm` dialog for `Submit Orders` in Storybook
issues.body:
I think we have a `z-index` problem with `StoryBook`.   In the `Storybook` for `index4`, the `Confirm` dialog doesn't get shown.  I've searched from dev tools, and it's in the DOM, but not visible.

Steps to reproduce:
- `yarn storybook`
- Open Mapping - Small Scale - Natural Earth
- Verify controls indicate we're `umpire force` (or Game Control)  in `adjudication phase`
- Open top-left `Control` tab
- Click on `Accept all routes`
- Click on `Submit New State`
- Observer that we don't see the `Are you sure you wish to submit new state?` dialog

Failing behaviour in StoryBook:
![stprybook](https://i.gyazo.com/15a23815469356318a4e33ef4dea310c.gif)

Working behaviour in develop:
![develop](https://i.gyazo.com/24f9f0e996f0b64defb12ca69e9fd4c5.gif)
